$comment: The OP-XY's physical controls as data: our own structuring and wording of public facts (TE's guide, product pages and drawings, community MIDI research). Not affiliated with Teenage Engineering. Positions are millimetres measured from TE's drawings (see docs/research/50-hardware-ui.md); every entry carries confidence + source keys (see `sources`). Validated by src/lib/core/opxy (zod) - run its tests after editing.

idScheme.pattern: <group>.<name>, lower case; ids are stable - a rename adds an alias instead

groups.key: the 20 function keys: project, tempo, sample, com, instrument, auxiliary, arrange, mix, m1-m4, player, bar, record, play, stop, minus, plus, shift
groups.track: track keys 1-8: instrument tracks 1-8 in instrument mode, auxiliary tracks 9-16 in auxiliary mode (T1 brain ... T8 FX II)
groups.keyboard: the 24 keyboard keys by note at the default octave with C4 = 60: f3, fs3 (F sharp 3), g3 ... e5; naturals double as step components, accidentals as digits 1-9, 0
groups.encoder: the endless encoders 1-4, left to right dark gray, mid gray, light gray, white (turn + click)
groups.led: led.charge; LED windows on keys live in their key entry (`led`)
groups.speaker: speaker.internal

idScheme.keyGrammarTokens: `token` is the spelling used by the key-combo grammar (src/lib/core/opxy/keys.ts), e.g. "shift + M1", "step 5 + turn E2"

faces.top: plan view: origin at the body top-left (back-left) corner, x to the right (0-285), y toward the player (0-102); the power-switch tab is excluded
faces.front: front face: x as on the top face, y downward from the top rim
faces.right: right face: x from the back edge toward the player (0-102), y downward from the top rim

conventions.rect: rect = bounds of the control; for grid controls the full pitch cell (the visible tile is inset by the tile gap), which is also the hit area
conventions.center: center = actuator centre (keycap, knob or feature); it can differ from the tile centre (accidentals, volume)
conventions.notes: MIDI note numbers are authoritative; names use C4 = 60 (leftmost key F3 = 53). The device names its own sample files with C3 = 60.
conventions.legend: legend.printed describes what is printed on the cap; the OP-XY prints no shift legends, so legend.shift describes the shift-layer function in our words

HW-NOTE.note: our measurements, inventory and legend descriptions

TE-HOWTO.note: names track 5 as the external audio track in auxiliary mode

TE-LAYOUT-SVG.note: TE's full-panel line drawing; reference only, never shipped

TE-TOPDOWN.note: TE's orthographic top render (asset 6735138db0f88c1a719dbd38); reference only, never shipped

TE-PORTS.note: TE product image 67361db01db2feb0839f4196 (right edge); reference only

TE-GUIDE-SVG.note: colours used in TE's guide illustrations; reference only
